segments.title: The page is the screenshot
sentences: This page has a screenshot tool inside it.
On the right is a live app, drawn on a canvas.
Press the shutter, and the drawing freezes into a picture.
Then you mark it up without leaving the tab.
segments.notes: Open on the real page. Push into the capture station. The live Northstar preview breathes. The shutter presses, the flash fires, and the frozen bitmap takes over.

segments.title: The freeze
sentences: The preview is not an image.
It is a canvas, painted fresh thirty times a second.
The shutter copies its pixels at device resolution into a second canvas.
The backing bitmap is capped at two and a half times the CSS size.
The live layer fades, and the copy takes its place.
segments.notes: A pipeline diagram: live canvas, DPR-scaled backing store, offscreen frozen bitmap. The real stage sits beside it. Show 2.5x pixels.

segments.title: The selection
sentences: The frozen canvas becomes an editor.
Drag a rectangle, and everything outside it dims.
Eight handles resize it, and a tag reports the pixel size.
The rectangle is stored as fractions, so it survives a resize.
segments.notes: Real captured stage. Drag a selection over the signal chart and review notes. Show the eight handles and the 780 x 420 tag. Then a 0..1 normalized coordinate inset.

segments.title: Three marks
sentences: Three tools mark up the capture.
Arrow points. Box frames.
Blur redacts with a mosaic built from the frozen pixels underneath.
Each mark is stored as geometry, not baked into the image.
It redraws cleanly at any size.
segments.notes: Draw an arrow to the retention card, a box around the LIVE chip, and a blur over the review note email. Then show the mosaic grid resolving from the frozen bitmap.

segments.title: The clean copy
sentences: Copy and Download do not read the screen.
They build a clean canvas from the frozen bitmap.
Annotations go on top, and the selection becomes the crop.
The veil, the handles, and the toolbar are left behind.
What you get is a PNG at native resolution.
segments.notes: Pipeline: frozen bitmap plus annotations, crop to selection, clean PNG. Show the real exported PNG as an object, sharper than the display canvas. A 1440-wide screen can produce a 2.5x image.

segments.title: Made from scratch
sentences: The shutter has a sound, but there is no audio file.
It is filtered noise, a low thump, and a click.
The copy chime is three sine notes.
A soft error tone plays if the clipboard refuses.
The audio engine starts inside your click, so nothing autoplays.
segments.notes: Three waveforms and envelopes: noise burst, low sine thump, click. Then three chime notes on a staff-like grid. A gesture gate unlocks the AudioContext.

segments.title: The clock
sentences: The preview breathes at about thirty frames a second.
The endpoint pulses, the LIVE dot blinks, and a scan crosses the chart.
Hide the tab, or scroll away, and the loop stops.
Freeze the image, and the clock stops with it.
segments.notes: One RAF pulse feeding three bars: endpoint, LIVE dot, chart scan. Two gates close: visibility and capture. The bars flatten and the frame holds.

segments.title: Nothing to download
sentences: The preview, the icons, and the sounds are all code.
No image files. No audio files. No UI library.
Only the fonts come from outside.
The app is drawn, not screenshotted.
So the demo can capture itself with no server in the loop.
segments.notes: An asset ledger: images 0, audio 0, video 0, UI libraries 0, fonts 2. Then lines of Canvas 2D draw calls drawing the Northstar UI.

segments.title: The quiet defaults
sentences: The capture still works when the motion stops.
Reduced motion removes the flash, the shake, and the entrances.
The freeze becomes a fade, and every tool still works.
Keyboard users get C, V, A, R, B, and Escape.
The layout holds on a phone.
segments.notes: Three panels: reduced motion, keyboard map, phone layout using the real 390 x 844 capture. Every claim is visible.

segments.title: The page is the screenshot
sentences: A page that can see itself.
A screenshot you never have to leave.
The pixels stay in the tab.
The page is the screenshot.
segments.notes: Pull back from the frozen frame to the whole page. The crop marks settle around the stage. Final line stands alone, then silence.
